<function name="ToHWB" parent="Color" type="classfunc">
	<file line="158-L163">lua/includes/util/color.lua</file>

	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>

		<ret name="hue" type="number">The hue in degrees [0, 360).</ret>

	</rets>
</function>
